steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Okay! It's dismantled!
This isn't a very complicated bomb, but Christina doesn't have time to think about that, she has more pressing matters.

The door to the driver's seat swings open with a clatter, allowing a gust of wind and shards of shattered glass to flood into the carriage where Christina is. She quickly rushes out, her first action being to grab the Mania Puppet.
She hurls the Puppet out of the window and quickly grabs hold of the steering wheel herself. Searching for the brakes, she realizes that they have been removed.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Coquelic!
Lifting her head again, she finds that Coquelic has already taken a seat on the hood of the car, her back to Christina. Her hair, streaming through the broken windshield, obscures Christina's view.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: It's 11:56, almost time.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: I've already defused the bomb, you—

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Oh, is that so? Well done. Do you want me to praise you?

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Stop messing with me! That was the simplest of traps, even an amateur like me could easily disarm it. You never intended to kill anyone with that!

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: If you weren't aiming to kill the Commander-in-Chief, then who is your real target? And why are you doing this?

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: What are you trying to tell us?
The wind makes her voice somewhat unclear.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: The Hush squad has given up on forcibly attacking this vehicle. They can't do anything about me. They did leave a final ultimatum, though. They said that one minute before entering the danger zone, they would detonate the entire vehicle.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: You bastard! Give me your phone, I'll tell them that the bomb has been defused, that it's safe now! All we need to do is stop the car, I can drive it until it runs out of fuel if necessary!

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: I already told them that.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Huh?

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Five minutes before you disarmed the bomb, I knew you could do it. So I sent a message to the Hush.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: She hasn't responded to me yet. Do you think it's because she hasn't seen it? Or because she doesn't believe it?

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: ...What did you say...

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Or is it because...
Far ahead on the road, a blurry figure appears. Just by the silhouette, Christina recognizes who that is.
Shalom is standing in the middle of the road, with Rahu at her side.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Oh, isn't that your beacon of justice?
Christina can no longer hear Coquelic's taunts. She sees the black Grim Reaper, the Paradeisos weapon known as "Schorl," slowly opening.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: ...Shalom...?
She has seen its power before. It was once a magnificent force for justice that she trusted immensely.
But now, it fills her with fear.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: I did it... I've already stopped her, believe me... I beg you...

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Don't use it... Please...
Schorl slowly unfurls, as if amassing energy. It analyzes the scene, as if calculating death toll. Waves of light flow over it, like a cruel countdown.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: By the way, that old man won't die so easily, otherwise, the Underground guy wouldn't have asked me to do this.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: But I can't say the same for the others in this vehicle.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Including you.
She looks ahead at the road, where the Hush is standing in the center, along with that black-clothed guardian.
Coquelic scoffs disdainfully, flips back onto the roof of the car and leaves, but not before uttering one last sentence.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Goodbye, envoy of justice.
Right now, the only person in Chris' eyes is Shalom. The broken car window allows them to recognize each other at this distance.
Shalom's expression is like a frozen statue until, at one moment, Christina sees her lips move.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Position, force, timing...

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Go.

A blue light shoots vertically into the sky from the center of Schorl. Several rings of light are immediately projected onto the ground in front of the vehicle. The moment the uncontrolled vehicle drives into them, something descends from the sky.
White light covers everything in front of Chris' eyes, and a massive shockwave flips her over. The airbag deploys but is of little use as Chris' head slams hard onto the ground.
